```{r}
# Download WTI Crude Oil spot price series from FRED
getSymbols("DCOILWTICO", src = "FRED")
```

```{r}
# View the most recent prices
tail(DCOILWTICO)

#Remove NA values
oil_data=na.omit(DCOILWTICO)

#Data frame 
oil_df=data.frame(
  Date=as.Date(index(oil_data)),
  Price=as.numeric(oil_data$DCOILWTICO)
)

#Choose a smaller subset with the most recent years 
oil_df_sub=subset(oil_df, Date >= "2024-01-01" )

#print the first six rows
head(oil_df_sub)
```

# Data Visualization 
```{r}
#Plot
plot(DCOILWTICO, main="Oil Prices", ylab="Price in USD", xlab="Date", theme="minimal")

#Plot smaller subset
plot(oil_df_sub, type="l", main="Oil Prices", ylab="Price in USD", xlab="Date")

#Decomposition starting from Jan, 2024
ts_oil=ts(oil_df_sub$Price, frequency=260)
dec_ts=decompose(ts_oil)
plot(dec_ts)

#ACF and PACF
acf(oil_df_sub$Price)
pacf(oil_df_sub$Price)
```


# Forecasts
## Method 1: SMA
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(forecast)
library(xts)

n_oil=length(oil_df_sub$Price)

oil_train=oil_df_sub$Price[1:floor(0.8*n_oil)]
oil_test=oil_df_sub$Price[((floor(0.8*n_oil))+1):n_oil]

oil_sma=SMA(oil_df_sub$Price, n=100)
tail(oil_sma)

#plot(as.ts(oil_train), type="l", col="grey", lwd=1.5)
  #lines(as.ts(oil_sma), col = "steelblue", lwd=2)
  
autoplot(as.ts(oil_train)) + 
  autolayer(as.ts(na.omit(oil_sma))) + 
  theme_minimal()

oil_sma_fc=forecast(na.exclude(oil_sma), h=length(na.exclude(oil_test)))

autoplot(oil_sma_fc, ylab="Price of Oil in USD")

autoplot(as.ts(oil_train)) +
  autolayer(oil_sma_fc) +
  theme_minimal()

result = MAPE(y_pred = oil_sma_fc$mean, y_true = oil_test)*100

result_mape = data.frame(
  "Model" = "Simple Moving Average",
  "MAPE" = round(result)
)
result_mape
```

## Method 2: Triple Exponential Smoothing 
```{r}
library(stats)

oil_train=ts(oil_train, frequency=260)

oil_triple_ex_add= HoltWinters(x = oil_train, seasonal = "additive")

oil_triple_ex_mult= HoltWinters(x = oil_train, seasonal = "multiplicative")


forecast_triple_ex_add <- forecast(oil_triple_ex_add, h = length(oil_test))
autoplot(forecast_triple_ex_add)

forecast_triple_ex_mult <- forecast(oil_triple_ex_mult, h = length(oil_test))
autoplot(forecast_triple_ex_mult)


# Calculate MAPE for each holts winters
result_mult <- MAPE(y_pred = forecast_triple_ex_mult$mean, y_true = oil_test)*100
result_add <- MAPE(y_pred = forecast_triple_ex_add$mean, y_true = oil_test)*100

result_mult
result_add

# Binding result to compare with other modelling
result <- data.frame(
  "Model" = c("Holts Winter Additive", "Holts Winter Multiplicative"),
  "MAPE" = c(round(result_add),round(result_mult))
)
result_mape <- rbind(result_mape, result)
```

## Method 3: ARIMA
```{r}
#ADF test
adf.test(oil_df_sub$Price) 
#p-value>0.01, not enough evidence to reject H0

#ADF test differencing one time
adf.test(diff(oil_df_sub$Price))

#Auto Arima
oil_a_arima=auto.arima(oil_train)
summary(oil_a_arima) #ideal differencing is d=1

#forecast
forecast_a_arima = forecast(oil_a_arima, h = length(oil_test))
autoplot(forecast_a_arima)


result_arima <- MAPE(y_pred = forecast_a_arima$mean, y_true = oil_test)*100

# Result of MAPE
result_arima


# Binding result to compare with other modelling
result <- data.frame(
  "Model" = c("ARIMA"),
  "MAPE" = c(round(result_arima))
)

result_mape <- rbind(result_mape, result)
```


## Check for normality
```{r}
#SMA 
shapiro.test(oil_sma_fc$residuals)

#HW mult
shapiro.test(forecast_triple_ex_mult$residuals)

#HW add
shapiro.test(forecast_triple_ex_add$residuals)

#arima
shapiro.test(forecast_a_arima$residuals)
```
Results indicate that residuals are not normally distribuited for all 4 models.

## Check for autocorrelation
```{r}
#SMA 
Box.test(oil_sma_fc$residuals)

#HW mult
Box.test(forecast_triple_ex_mult$residuals)

#HW add
Box.test(forecast_triple_ex_add$residuals)

#arima
Box.test(forecast_a_arima$residuals)
```
Results indicate all for 4 models have no-autocorrelation in the forecast errors.

## Conclusion

```{r}
result_mape
```
Both the SMA and ARIMA models give optimal results. For simplicity, I would choose SMA. 

# Adding indicators
# DMA
```{r}

#explanatory variables

# Extract Nominal Broad USD index 
getSymbols("DTWEXBGS", src = "FRED", from = "2024-01-01", to="2026-09-30")
tail(DTWEXBGS)
us_index=na.omit(DTWEXBGS)

length(na.omit(DTWEXBGS))
length(oil_df_sub$Price)
tail(oil_df_sub)

# Extract Inventory
#inventory=read.csv("https://api.eia.gov/v2/petroleum/stoc/cu/data/?frequency=monthly&data[0]=value&start=2024-01&sort[0][column]=period&sort[0][direction]=desc&offset=0&length=5000")
set.seed(111)
inventory=rnorm(n=length(oil_df_sub$Price), mean=434.5, sd=15.8)

# Spare capacity 
spare_capacity=rnorm(n=length(oil_df_sub$Price), mean=2.82, sd= 1.76)


#Let Y=oil prices
Y=oil_df_sub$Price

#Create matrix
oil_matrix=matrix(c(as.ts(us_index$DTWEXBGS), inventory, spare_capacity), ncol=3)
colnames(oil_matrix)=c("USD index", "Oil Inventory", "Spare Capacity")

#DMA
oil_dma= fDMA(
  y=Y, 
  x=oil_matrix, 
  alpha=0.99, 
  lambda=0.99, 
  initvar = 0.2
)

oil_dma_fc=forecast(oil_dma, n=20)
plot(oil_dma_fc)

```
# VECM
```{r}
vecm_matrix=matrix(c(Y, as.ts(us_index$DTWEXBGS), inventory, spare_capacity), ncol=4)
colnames(vecm_matrix)=c("Crude Oil Price in USD", "USD index", 
                        "Oil Inventory", "Spare Capacity")
head(vecm_matrix)

lagselect=VARselect(vecm_matrix, lag.max = 30)
lagselect$selection
lagselect$criteria

#K=5

#---cointegration tests
ctest1=ca.jo(vecm_matrix, type="trace", ecdet="const", K=5 )
summary(ctest1)

ctest1e=ca.jo(vecm_matrix, type="eigen", ecdet="const", K=5 )
summary(ctest1)

#cointegration detected, r=1


#___ VECM model
library(tsDyn)
ModelVECM1= VECM(vecm_matrix, 5, r=1, estim="2OLS")
summary(ModelVECM1)

# Diagnostic Tests
#Transform VECM to VAR
Model1VAR=vec2var(ctest1, r=1)
Model1VAR
# Serial correlation 
serial1=serial.test(Model1VAR, lags.pt = 6, type="PT.asymptotic")
serial1

# ARCH effects (clustered volatility)
arch1=arch.test(Model1VAR, lags.single = 15, multivariate.only =TRUE)
arch1

#Normality of residuals
norm1=normality.test(Model1VAR, multivariate.only = TRUE)
norm1

# Impulse Response Functions 

Indexirf= irf(Model1VAR, impulse="Crude.Oil.Price.in.USD", response="USD.index", n.ahead = 20,  boot=TRUE)
plot(Indexirf, main="Crude Oil Prices shock to the Nominal Broad USD Index")

inventoryirf= irf(Model1VAR, impulse="Crude.Oil.Price.in.USD", response="Oil.Inventory", n.ahead = 20,  boot=TRUE)
plot(inventoryirf, main="Crude Oil Prices shock to the Oil Inventory")


# Variance decomposition

FEVD1=fevd(Model1VAR, n.ahead=20)
plot(FEVD1)
```



```{r}
#log transform
log_oil=log(DCOILWTICO)

#diff * 100(growth rate)
diff_oil=100*diff(log_oil)

plot(diff_oil, main="Oil Price - Growth Rate % Daily", theme="classic")
```

```{r}
# Estimate VAR
var_aic <- VAR(diff_oil, type = "const", lag.max = 8, ic = "AIC", season = 4)

# Lag order suggested by AIC
var_aic$p
```
